name: kalpana-designer
description: Design editable Kalpana templates from a brief: layers, layout flows, charts and motion, checked by rendering, ready to fill with data in bulk.

interface.longDescription: Kalpana Designer creates editable marketing designs (social posts, banners, ads, carousels and slides) from a brief. Give the intent, platforms and brand, and it builds the design in your Kalpana workspace: layout flows, text that fits, your fonts, logos and product photos, charts, shapes and motion. It checks the layout and renders previews before handing over a template that is ready for bulk rendering with Kalpana Batch.
defaultPrompt: Design a 1080x1080 post for my brand's new product with a photo, headline and call to action.
Make a story-size copy of my latest template.
Turn this template into a five-page carousel.
